# Part 2: Cluster Overview

```{r knitr-setup-part2, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(

  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  fig.width  = 12,
  fig.height = 10,
  dpi     = 150
)
```

## 2.1 Configuration

```{r config-part2}
cfg <- list(
  object_file = file.path(path$objects, "03_xALD_filtered_integrated.qs"),
  label_col   = "celltypes",
  assay       = "RNA",
  reduction   = "umap_harmony",
  umap_ncol   = 3,
  pt_size     = 0.25
)
expr_cols <- c("#f5e642", "#FF0000")
```

## 2.2 Load

```{r load-object-part2}
xALD_filtered <- add_severity(qread(cfg$object_file))
xALD_filtered <- lapply(xALD_filtered, function(so) {
  DefaultAssay(so) <- cfg$assay
  lab <- as.character(so@meta.data[[cfg$label_col]])
  lab[lab %in% c("", "NA") | grepl("^[0-9]+$", lab)] <- NA
  so$celltype_lab <- lab
  so <- so[, !is.na(so$celltype_lab)]
  so$celltype_lab <- factor(so$celltype_lab, levels = sort(unique(so$celltype_lab)))
  Idents(so) <- "celltype_lab"
  so
})
imap_dfr(xALD_filtered, function(so, comp)
  setNames(as.data.frame(table(so$celltype_lab)), c("celltype", "n_cells")) %>%
    mutate(compartment = comp, .before = 1)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Cells per labelled cluster")
```

## 2.5 Marker UMAPs

```{r marker-umaps}
gene_panels <- list(
  "B-Cells"       = c("CD19", "CD79A", "PAX5"),
  "NK Cells"      = c("NCR1", "SH2D1B", "KLRF1"),
  "CD8+T-Cells"   = c("CD8A", "CD8B", "GZMK"),
  "CD4+T-Cells"   = c("CD40LG", "TESPA1", "MAL"),
  "pDC"           = c("CLEC4C", "LILRA4", "SCT"),
  "Myeloid Cells" = c("CSF1R", "MNDA", "LYZ"))

marker_feature_plot <- function(so, genes) {
  n <- min(cfg$umap_ncol, length(genes))
  p <- if (requireNamespace("scCustomize", quietly = TRUE))
    scCustomize::FeaturePlot_scCustom(so, features = genes, reduction = cfg$reduction,
                                      colors_use = expr_cols, na_color = "grey85", order = TRUE,
                                      pt.size = cfg$pt_size, num_columns = n)
  else
    Seurat::FeaturePlot(so, features = genes, reduction = cfg$reduction, order = TRUE,
                        pt.size = cfg$pt_size, ncol = n)
  p & theme_umap_panel()
}

for (comp in names(xALD_filtered)) {
  so <- xALD_filtered[[comp]]
  for (ct in names(gene_panels)) {
    genes <- intersect(gene_panels[[ct]], rownames(so))
    if (!length(genes)) next
    p <- marker_feature_plot(so, genes) +
      patchwork::plot_annotation(title = paste0(comp, " - ", ct))
    print(p)
    ggsave(file.path(path$marker_umap, paste0("umap_panel_markers_", comp, "_", sanitize(ct), ".png")),
           p, width = 4 * min(cfg$umap_ncol, length(genes)),
           height = 3.6 * ceiling(length(genes) / cfg$umap_ncol), dpi = 300, limitsize = FALSE)
  }
}
```

## 2.6 Differential abundance

```{r coarse-ab-params}
par_ab_coarse <- list(
  label_col       = "celltype_lab",
  donor_col       = "patient_ID",
  group_col       = "diagnosis",
  compartment_col = "compartment",
  strat_col       = "severity_active",
  ref_group       = "control",
  min_cells       = 5,
  min_samples     = 0.5,
  fdr             = 0.05
)
meta_all_coarse <- ab_get_meta(xALD_filtered, par_ab_coarse$compartment_col)
```

### 2.6.1 X-ALD vs control

```{r coarse-ab-fit, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 5}
ab_coarse <- list()
for (comp in names(xALD_filtered)) {
  ab <- tryCatch(
    build_abundance_inputs(
      meta_all_coarse,
      compartment_col = par_ab_coarse$compartment_col, focus = comp,
      donor_col = par_ab_coarse$donor_col, group_col = par_ab_coarse$group_col,
      label_col = par_ab_coarse$label_col, strat_col = par_ab_coarse$strat_col,
      ref_group = par_ab_coarse$ref_group,
      min_cells = par_ab_coarse$min_cells, min_samples = par_ab_coarse$min_samples),
    error = function(e) { message(comp, ": ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  if (is.null(ab)) next

  design <- model.matrix(~ group, data = ab$sinfo)
  colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))
  coef <- setdiff(colnames(design), "X.Intercept.")[1]
  if (is.na(coef)) next

  res <- tryCatch(fit_ab(ab$mat, ab$sinfo, ab$totals, design, coef = coef, fdr = par_ab_coarse$fdr),
                  error = function(e) { message(comp, " fit: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
  if (is.null(res)) next
  res <- res %>% dplyr::arrange(FDR) %>% dplyr::mutate(compartment = comp, .before = 1)

  print(plot_ab_figure(
    ab$long, res, ab$totals, pal = umap_palette_for(fig_all_umap, comp, ab$long$celltype),
    title_a = paste("Per-donor composition —", comp),
    title_b_prefix = "X-ALD vs control",
    y_lab = paste("proportion of all labelled", comp, "cells"),
    fdr = par_ab_coarse$fdr,
    out_file = file.path(path$abundance, paste0("abundance_coarse_edgeR_", sanitize(comp), ".png"))))

  readr::write_csv(res, file.path(path$tables, paste0("abundance_coarse_", sanitize(comp), ".csv")))
  ab_coarse[[comp]] <- list(inputs = ab, res = res)
}

store_figure_panels("allCells", "abundance", abundance_figure_panels(
  ab_coarse, umap_fig = fig_all_umap, ref_group = par_ab_coarse$ref_group,
  contrast = "X-ALD vs control", fdr = par_ab_coarse$fdr,
  y_lab = "proportion of labelled cells"))
```

### 2.6.2 Compositional check

```{r coarse-ab-compositional}
comp_coarse <- dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(ab_coarse), function(comp)
  ab_compositional(ab_coarse[[comp]]$inputs, ab_coarse[[comp]]$res) %>% dplyr::mutate(compartment = comp, .before = 1)))
readr::write_csv(comp_coarse, file.path(path$tables, "abundance_coarse_compositional.csv"))
knitr::kable(comp_coarse, digits = 3, caption = "All cells, X-ALD vs control: share vs compositional tests")
```
